predictions.guard_summary: There are no explicit guards or controls against deep recursion or circular references in the function. The function does not validate the depth of nesting or check for circular object references, which could lead to uncontrolled recursion.
predictions.risk_pattern: The deepMixin function can cause unbounded recursion when processing objects with circular references or deeply nested structures, leading to potential stack overflow or denial of service through excessive resource consumption.

When both the source and target values are plain objects, it recursively calls itself to continue the mixin process. The recursion depth depends on the structure of the input objects, with no built-in limits or checks against circular references.
